name: Sammy Newsome
features: fair skin, dark hair parted and oiled, light eyes, round cheerful face, medium stocky build, brisk salesman’s confidence
bio: Samuel Herbert Newsome, Coventry motor trader and the SS distributor who talked William Lyons into letting the SS 100 go racing at all. He campaigned his own car hard in hillclimbs and rallies and in 1938 persuaded the factory to build the fixed-head coupé version. Later he bought the Coventry Hippodrome and turned it into one of the great pantomime houses of the Midlands.
